critical_code_review_comments: api.js interceptor: sessionExpiryHandled guard reset at 10s is good. Consider debouncing toast within the guard window explicitly via toast.dismiss() to avoid rare stacking if two 401s fire in the same microtask before guard flips.

VerbalToVariation.jsx: onGenerate does not catch abort/network as distinct from 5xx before checking err.response — current branch order handles it via `!err?.response` after other status checks; correct behaviour verified in UI.
